kicker: Cervical Cancer · Front Oncol 2024;14:1481626 · Real-World Two-Center
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Front Oncol 2024;14:1481626 · 真实世界双中心
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation Triage Across HPV Genotypes and Age Groups in hrHPV+ Women
title_zh: hrHPV阳性女性中 PAX1/JAM3 甲基化分流效能：按HPV型别与年龄分层
subtitle: Two-center real-world study of CISCER® in 436 hrHPV-positive women — AUC 0.941 for CIN2+
subtitle_zh: 双中心真实世界研究，436 例 hrHPV 阳性女性——CIN2+ 检测 AUC 0.941
authors: Liang H, Liu Y, Yin S, Jiang M, et al.
authors_zh: 梁慧, 刘瑶, 尹素月, 蒋梦雨 等

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: cytology-based triage of hrHPV+ women is subjective and misses lesions under low-grade cytology; genotype- and age-specific performance of PAX1/JAM3 methylation was unclear.
Question: does CISCER® triage hrHPV+ women for CIN2+ across HPV genotypes and age groups?
Why it matters: objective triage could cut unnecessary colposcopy while catching lesions hidden by normal/low-grade cytology.
bullets_zh: 空白：hrHPV+ 女性的细胞学分流主观性强，易漏诊细胞学低级别下的病变；PAX1/JAM3 甲基化在不同型别与年龄的表现未明。
问题：CISCER® 能否在不同HPV型别与年龄组的 hrHPV+ 女性中分流 CIN2+？
意义：客观分流可减少不必要阴道镜，同时捕获细胞学正常/低级别掩盖的病变。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: real-world two-center cross-sectional (Dec 2022–May 2024); opportunistic screening; histology-confirmed (283 normal / 53 CIN1 / 40 CIN2 / 34 CIN3 / 26 cancer).
Methylation: CISCER® PAX1/JAM3 PCR-fluorescence (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0).
Comparators: TCT cytology (≥ASC-US) and hrHPV genotyping (Yaneng 15-type).
Analysis: CIN2+ detection across HPV genotypes (16/18 vs other hrHPV) and age strata (<30 / 30–49 / ≥50 y).
bullets_zh: 设计：真实世界双中心横断面（2022.12–2024.5）；机会性筛查；组织学确诊（正常 283 / CIN1 53 / CIN2 40 / CIN3 34 / 癌 26）。
甲基化：CISCER® PAX1/JAM3 PCR-荧光法（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）。
对照：TCT 细胞学（≥ASC-US）与 hrHPV 分型（亚能15型）。
分析：按 HPV 型别（16/18 vs 其他hrHPV）与年龄（<30 / 30–49 / ≥50岁）分层的 CIN2+ 检出。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CISCER for CIN2+: sensitivity 92.6% · specificity 95.7% · AUC 0.941 (0.903–0.979) — far above TCT (sens 91.5% / spec 45% / AUC 0.683).
All 26 cancers detected — including 2 HPV-negative adenocarcinomas.
Age effect: sensitivity 100% in ≥50 y; specificity 100% in <30 y.
Hidden cases caught: 37.2% of CIN2+ with NILM/ASC-US/LSIL cytology were detected by CISCER.
bullets_zh: CISCER 检测 CIN2+：灵敏度 92.6% · 特异度 95.7% · AUC 0.941（0.903–0.979）——远高于 TCT（灵敏度 91.5% / 特异度 45% / AUC 0.683）。
26 例宫颈癌全部检出——含 2 例 hrHPV 阴性腺癌。
年龄效应：≥50 岁灵敏度 100%；<30 岁特异度 100%。
捕获隐匿病例：37.2% 细胞学 NILM/ASC-US/LSIL 的 CIN2+ 被 CISCER 检出。

panels.title: Risk stratification
bullets: Post-test risk: CISCER(+) → immediate CIN3+ risk 54% (43.8–63.9%) vs 0.3% when negative — a 180× risk gradient.
Genotype independence: CISCER performed across HPV16/18 and other hrHPV genotypes; specificity remained high in all strata.
Comparison: TCT ≥ASC-US had 45% specificity — CISCER more than doubled it (95.7%) at comparable sensitivity.
bullets_zh: 检验后风险：CISCER(+) → 即时 CIN3+ 风险 54%（43.8–63.9%）vs 阴性 0.3%——180 倍风险梯度。
型别无关性：CISCER 在 HPV16/18 与其他 hrHPV 型别中均有效，各亚组特异度保持高水平。
对比：TCT ≥ASC-US 特异度仅 45%——CISCER 在相近灵敏度下将其提高一倍以上（95.7%）。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Methylation > cytology: AUC 0.941 vs 0.683 — objective, reproducible triage for hrHPV+ women across genotypes and ages.
Catches the hidden cases: detects HPV-negative adenocarcinoma and CIN2+ under low-grade cytology — fewer missed lesions, fewer needless colposcopies.
bullets_zh: 甲基化优于细胞学：AUC 0.941 vs 0.683——hrHPV+ 女性跨型别、跨年龄的客观可重复分流。
捕获隐匿病变：检出 HPV 阴性腺癌与细胞学低级别下的 CIN2+——少漏诊、少不必要的阴道镜。

kicker: Cervical Cancer · BMC Cancer 2024;24:1385 · Real-World Cross-Sectional
kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · BMC Cancer 2024;24:1385 · 真实世界横断面
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation in the Triage of ASC-US
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化在 ASC-US 分流中的应用
subtitle: 322 women with ASC-US — CISCER® sensitivity 83.8% / specificity 95.8%, cutting colposcopy referrals by 79.5%
subtitle_zh: 322 例 ASC-US 女性——CISCER® 灵敏度 83.8% / 特异度 95.8%，阴道镜转诊减少 79.5%
authors: Chen X, Jiang H, Xu H, Wang L, et al.
authors_zh: 陈晓燕, 蒋海明, 徐虎滨, 王林海 等

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: ASC-US is the most common abnormal cytology — management is debated; HPV triage has high sensitivity but near-zero specificity (10.8%).
Question: can PAX1/JAM3 methylation triage ASC-US women better than HPV alone, reducing over-referral?
Why it matters: an objective triage for the largest abnormal-cytology group could spare millions of needless colposcopies.
bullets_zh: 空白：ASC-US 是最常见的异常细胞学——处理方案存争议；HPV 分流灵敏度高但特异度近乎为零（10.8%）。
问题：PAX1/JAM3 甲基化能否比单独 HPV 更好地分流 ASC-US 女性，减少过度转诊？
意义：为最大异常细胞学人群提供客观分流，可省去数以百万计的不必要阴道镜检查。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: real-world cross-sectional, single center (Mar 2022–Jan 2024); opportunistic screening; histology reference.
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); Cobas 4800 HPV; TCT.
Groups: 80 HPV16/18+, 206 non-16/18 hrHPV+, 36 hrHPV−; CIN2+ in 37/203 with histology.
Outcome: CIN2+ triage performance vs HPV and cytology.
bullets_zh: 设计：真实世界横断面、单中心（2022.3–2024.1）；机会性筛查；组织学金标准。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；Cobas 4800 HPV；TCT。
分组：HPV16/18+ 80 例、非16/18 hrHPV+ 206 例、hrHPV− 36 例；203 例有组织学，其中 CIN2+ 37 例。
结局：CIN2+ 分流效能 vs HPV 与细胞学。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CISCER for CIN2+: sensitivity 83.8% · specificity 95.8% · AUC 0.898 — HPV: 100% sens but only 10.8% spec (8.8× lower).
Single genes: PAX1m sens 70.3% · JAM3m sens 64.8% — dual-gene combination is best.
Referrals cut 79.5%: 147/185 hrHPV+ ASC-US women avoided colposcopy.
Best in non-16/18: sensitivity 90.5% in the non-16/18 hrHPV+ ASC-US subgroup.
bullets_zh: CISCER 检测 CIN2+：灵敏度 83.8% · 特异度 95.8% · AUC 0.898——HPV：灵敏度 100% 但特异度仅 10.8%（低 8.8 倍）。
单基因：PAX1m 灵敏度 70.3% · JAM3m 灵敏度 64.8%——双基因联合最优。
转诊减少 79.5%：147/185 例 hrHPV+ ASC-US 女性免于阴道镜。
非16/18亚组最优：非16/18 hrHPV+ ASC-US 亚组灵敏度 90.5%。

panels.title: Risk stratification
bullets: Post-test risk: CISCER(−) immediate CIN3+ risk 1.2% vs 39.5% when positive — a 33× gradient.
Relative specificity: CISCER specificity was 8.84× that of HPV triage — the key to cutting over-referral.
Safe rule-out: a negative CISCER in ASC-US women supports routine follow-up instead of colposcopy.
bullets_zh: 检验后风险：CISCER(−) 即时 CIN3+ 风险 1.2% vs 阳性 39.5%——33 倍梯度。
相对特异度：CISCER 特异度为 HPV 分流的 8.84 倍——这是减少过度转诊的关键。
安全排除：ASC-US 女性 CISCER 阴性可常规随访而非阴道镜。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Objective ASC-US triage: 83.8% sens / 95.8% spec — replaces near-zero-specificity HPV triage.
79.5% fewer colposcopies with post-test risk of only 1.2% when negative — safe, efficient ASC-US management.
bullets_zh: 客观的 ASC-US 分流：灵敏度 83.8% / 特异度 95.8%——取代近乎零特异度的 HPV 分流。
阴道镜减少 79.5%，阴性即时风险仅 1.2%——安全高效的 ASC-US 管理。
